description: Search codeitso's catalog of public app-building materials (fonts, colors, icons, UI kits, MCP servers, agent skills, public APIs incl. Korean public data, open-source libraries, templates, datasets) by keywords in Korean or English, e.g. '급식 API', 'chart library'. Returns ranked materials with id, one-line summary, license, popularity and key facts, plus matching subcategories. Install commands and full details: codeitso_get_materials.

response_format.description: 'json' for structured output; default compact markdown.

subcategory.description: Only this subcategory id from codeitso_browse, e.g. fonts-ko, icons, mcp, kr-public.

name: codeitso_search
